context: Tests the code-review skill's self-review mode (uncommitted changes, before commit/PR): review all changed files including untracked ones that `git diff` does not show, fix issues directly in the working directory rather than producing PR suggestions, scope block CSS with the block class (not a `main` prefix), report Must Fix / Recommendations with a ready-to-commit checklist, cover visual validation against the test content, and prepare the before/after preview URLs the PR will need.

checklist.name: Untracked block files reviewed
checklist.description: SELF-REVIEW.md lists `blocks/product-teaser/product-teaser.js` and `blocks/product-teaser/product-teaser.css` (untracked, absent from `git diff`) as reviewed, alongside `scripts/scripts.js`

checklist.name: Issues fixed in the working files
checklist.description: The review changes the project files themselves (not only a report): at least three of the issues below are fixed in the delivered files

checklist.name: Swiper removed from loadEager
checklist.description: `scripts/scripts.js` no longer loads Swiper in `loadEager` (nor anywhere else globally in scripts.js), and the now-unused `loadScript` import is removed; the block loads Swiper itself (e.g. `loadScript` from `../../scripts/aem.js` inside decorate, optionally deferred via IntersectionObserver) before calling `new Swiper`

checklist.name: scripts.js otherwise intact
checklist.description: Apart from removing the Swiper load/import, scripts.js keeps the boilerplate flow unchanged (loadEager still decorates main and awaits `loadSection(... waitForFirstImage)`; loadLazy/loadDelayed untouched)

checklist.name: Debug logging removed
checklist.description: The `console.log('decorating product-teaser', ...)` line is removed from product-teaser.js

checklist.name: CSS scoped with the block class
checklist.description: In product-teaser.css every rule targeting `.slide`, `.slide img` and `.slide-info ...` is scoped under `.product-teaser` (e.g. `.product-teaser .slide`), or classes are renamed with a `product-teaser-` prefix. Score 0 if selectors are prefixed with `main` (e.g. `main .product-teaser .slide`) or SELF-REVIEW.md recommends `main .<block>` scoping

checklist.name: Mobile-first media queries
checklist.description: The `@media (max-width: 899px)` rule is gone: its styles become the base (mobile) styles and only `width >=` (or `min-width`) queries remain

checklist.name: Inline styles and !important removed
checklist.description: `price.style.fontWeight` / `price.style.color` are replaced by CSS on the `price` class in product-teaser.css, and `margin: 0 !important` is replaced by a non-important declaration (specificity via block scoping)

checklist.name: Price fetch robustness addressed
checklist.description: The hardcoded `PRICE_API` URL and the unchecked `fetch`/`resp.json()` (no `resp.ok` check or try/catch, failure breaks the carousel) are either fixed in code or listed as open recommendations in SELF-REVIEW.md

checklist.name: Block still functional
checklist.description: product-teaser.js still default-exports `decorate(block)`, keeps the authored rows/pictures (moved, not recreated), and every class it relies on for styling exists in product-teaser.css after the changes

checklist.name: Must Fix vs Recommendations
checklist.description: SELF-REVIEW.md separates blocking items that must be fixed before committing from non-blocking recommendations (headings like "Must Fix Before Committing" and "Recommendations" or a clear equivalent), with file:line or file references, and marks which were fixed

checklist.name: Ready-to-commit checklist with lint
checklist.description: SELF-REVIEW.md ends with a ready-to-commit checklist or next steps that includes running `npm run lint` (ESLint + Stylelint) and confirming must-fix items are resolved before `git add`/`git commit`

checklist.name: Visual validation against test content
checklist.description: SELF-REVIEW.md addresses visual validation of `http://localhost:3000/drafts/jdoe/product-teaser` (or its preview URL) at mobile, tablet and desktop widths, either reporting screenshots taken or listing them explicitly as a remaining step (e.g. ~375/768/1200px)

checklist.name: PR preview URLs prepared
checklist.description: SELF-REVIEW.md states that the PR description needs before/after preview URLs and gives them: `https://main--northwind-site--northwind-outfitters.aem.page/drafts/jdoe/product-teaser` and `https://product-teaser--northwind-site--northwind-outfitters.aem.page/drafts/jdoe/product-teaser` (5 points if mentioned with wrong host format, branch, repo or owner)

checklist.name: No PR-review artifacts
checklist.description: The output does not create GitHub review payloads, ```suggestion blocks, or `gh api`/`gh pr` posting commands for this not-yet-opened change; findings are fixed or listed locally instead
